lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: Hey Snow, it’s been a while!

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Long time no see.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: Yes, so today I’m trying to get in touch to ask for help with something. Well, as I know, you’re a photographer.

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: That’s right.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: So I went to the HK Convention and Exhibition Centre two weeks ago, where a lot of Taiwanese companies tried to sell me on wedding photo [packages], that’s to say going to Taiwan for (three days and) two nights, which is a bit over $10000.

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Umm hmm.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: So I’d like to ask you how it’s actually like.

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Um...if it’s two nights in Taiwan...

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: A bit over $10000...did they mention how many photos are included?

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: So uh the shooting itself is done within one day. So I guess...the first day might be just for vacation, and then there’d be some make-up work and so on. So uh...it’ll be around $16000, with one set of photos included, maybe 40 or 50 of them. The pics themselves are pretty nice, from the samples I saw.

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Aha! But you’re there for 3 days for just one day of shooting?

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: Yes.

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: So it’s like...the first day is for shooting. And then the second day...

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: we simply enjoy our time, I guess...

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Which means the photographer is no longer involved. He’ll be off somewhere.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: But as far as I know, in Hong Kong...if you want to get some wedding photos, you’ll be hard-pressed to pay anything below ten-thousand-something, won’t you?

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Um...it’s actually true, if it’s Hong Kong. Er...ah! I’ve got to ask, uh, is only one photographer included?

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: There’s a photographer, then a make-up artist, and a stylist. Pretty much it.

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Yep.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: Plus a driver.

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Then it’s really not bad. Bear in mind that when it comes to photography in Hong Kong, in general...well...hiring one photographer for one day sets you back at least uh four...three to four thousand dollars.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: True.

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: So that’s the minimum. And then there’s the makeup artist, yup. And on top of that there is...for example, you gotta hire a van, you gotta book a van to drive you around all these places, and you need a stylist, when it comes to your wedding gown. One thing I have to ask – the gown is included, isn’t it?

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: It is, everything is. Yeah.

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Yeah right so that price is pretty reasonable. But since you need to hire a photographer and a make-up artist on top of everything else, for 2 nights in Taiwan, this price is really attractive.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: But apart from Taiwan, are there any other destinations worth considering?

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Of course there are, but can you tell me about your destination in Taiwan, uh...is it mainly some sort of nature or...or is it an urban location?

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: Eh...my future wife (lit.) likes hiking. Like she loves mountain scenery and so on, I think.

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Ah! Tons of destinations offer that. Frankly, even Hong Kong has it. The difference being that HK’s scenery might include more skyscrapers; whereas if you want a cheaper option, the mainland has that sort of thing as well. And the landscape on the mainland is really nice, by the way. But sometimes, I guess uh...well, some romantic couples or some married couples tend to be concerned about security, being in an unfamiliar environment and so on. So...uh if you prefer scenery with mountains and at the same time with water, then uh...lots of places will do, such as Thailand – these are pretty locations as well. Especially the water, yeah.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: Have you ever provided these wedding photography services for your clients?

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Well personally I shoot...like I don’t do wedding photography too often. I uh...I tend to shoot more photos for events, even though I have done wedding photos before. But that was in Hong Kong, not really in other places.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: Mmm-hmm. Yeah I guess I’ll just bring along my wife to discuss this again, this...topic.

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: You should! Yeah but I heard your brother has just got a set of wedding photos made as well?

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: He has! He did it in Hong Kong. So he joined a local company called Mona Lisa [Bridal Salon], and shot the photos around Ma Wan.

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: OK.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: Uh...so the entire set cost a bit over $10000. That’s why when I saw that it’s around $10000 in Taiwan, I thought that if it’s around $10000 as well, why not do it in Taiwan?

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Aha! But that Mona Lisa company you were talking about is like...offers a complete package, I know. Well uh their gowns are...well, quite beautiful, and you can choose among them, plus they have professional...make-up artists there to help. They’re also a pretty large company. Mmhmm... Mmhmm... Mmm-hmm...

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Which is why this price is reasonable. But if you compare them to those at the Wedding Expo, where there are lots more small startups, the prices should be relatively lower there. But hey, you know I’m a photographer, so if you want...like a little discount, I can work out a deal for you. So it all depends on where you’re going with it. We can talk about it later.

lines.speaker: Phillip
lines.english: Great, we can talk about it. Thanks for today.

lines.speaker: Snow
lines.english: Yep, no worries!

definition_overrides.ne1__呢: Particle signaling a pause, to emphasize the preceding words and allow the listener time to take them on board ("ok?", "are you with me?")
definition_overrides.leng4__零: used after a number or a quantifier to indicate 'a little more than'
definition_overrides.gam2joeng2__咁樣: like this; that way; this way
definition_overrides.zik1hai6__啫係: same as; exactly as; equivalent to; 'which means' or 'which is to say', usually used before explanations
